provenance.writtenFor: DROBON AEGIS original capability gap-closure master pump (2026-10-19)
provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: noopener-allow-popups is a valid cross-origin isolation mode and must not be reported as a weak COOP value.

groundTruth.rationale: COOP noopener-allow-popups keeps the same browsing-context-group isolation as same-origin for the opener relationship while letting popups open without an opener reference. It is not the default unsafe-none mode, so the control is present.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live request.
The rule cannot confirm that a popup with an opener actually exists.
